title: Define collision-safe Rust ASSIGNED_SF DIO option constant
description: rust/lichen-core/src/sf_assignment.rs imports constants::DIO_OPTION_ASSIGNED_SF and documents provisional RPL DIO option type 0x14, but rust/lichen-core/src/constants.rs defines no such constant. This leaves the module uncompilable when included and previously hid a registry collision with the Time Option. The authoritative project-local registry now reserves 0x12 DAO Origin Signature, 0x13 SCHC Rule Version, 0x14 Assigned SF, and 0x15 Time. Implement the Rust constant and ensure make/parse behavior matches the registry without confusing RPL option values with L2 dispatch values.
acceptance_criteria: Define DIO_OPTION_ASSIGNED_SF as 0x14 in the appropriate Rust protocol constants module; add/retain focused make/parse tests for [0x14,1,SF] and malformed/wrong-type inputs; verify no duplicate RPL option values across DAO Origin Signature 0x12, SCHC Rule Version 0x13, Assigned SF 0x14, and Time 0x15; update any Rust registry/cross-implementation vector wiring needed; cargo fmt, focused cargo test, and clippy pass; complete three independent correctness/security/robustness reviews before closing.
close_reason: Defined DIO_OPTION_ASSIGNED_SF=0x14 with project-registry documentation and executable roundtrip assertion.
